summary: First iteration of Merizo backend+frontend review. Backend: 16/17 pytest cases pass, 1 skipped (settle test – Goa already settled from prior runs). Frontend: login, dark-mode DotNum dot-matrix rendering, home carousel, Insights donut + period tabs, Profile, Category→Create Split 3-step wizard (all 3 steps reachable) all working. Minor UI/testID issues noted below.

minor.issue: Creates a negative-balance 'Settlement' expense that still appears in the expenses list with category='settlement'. Backend correctly skips is_settlement==true in /api/insights, but on GET /api/trips/{id} these rows show up in expenses[] and inflate trip.total_spent. UI may show phantom '✅ Settlement' row in Expenses tab.

Idempotent but does not re-seed trips if user has any trips (including user-created ones). This is documented behavior but means after a demo user creates a custom trip, re-seeding never restores missing demo trips.

ui_bugs.issue: Each tab has duplicated testID (e.g., tab-insights appears twice: once on icon wrapper, once on label). Playwright hits the first (hidden) element and errors 'Element is not visible'. Should place testID on a single parent (Pressable).

Only home-dot-N exists; there is no testID like home-card-N or carousel-card-N on the tappable card itself, making programmatic tap-to-navigate into Split Detail difficult. Consider adding testID={`home-card-${idx}`} to each card's Pressable.

issues: Goa card shows '₹37,200 of ₹30,000' with 100% bar – budget overflow is implicit; consider a red/over-budget indicator.
TEST_DelGuard leftover trip was visible until cleanup (now removed).
DotNum render is correct but ₹1,000 comma is missing a dot-matrix glyph in some spots (see screenshot) – the ',' is rendered tiny; visually fine at this size.

react_native_issues.issue: Console: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Many repeated warnings. Non-blocking but should migrate styles.
Console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' – inside StackedCarousel or similar. Non-blocking.
Expo warns react-native-svg@15.15.4 vs expected 15.12.1. Runtime works but align version with `yarn expo install react-native-svg`.

action_items: Dedupe bottom-tab testIDs – put testID only on Pressable (not on icon+label separately) in frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx.
Add testID={`home-card-${i}`} to each StackedCarousel card Pressable for navigation testability.
Consider hiding is_settlement==true expenses from Split Detail Expenses tab and from trip.total_spent to avoid double-counting after Settle.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across components to clear deprecation warnings.
Align react-native-svg version (`yarn expo install react-native-svg`).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 169: datetime freshness check has confusing ternary `if cached_at.tzinfo is None else now - cached_at` inside timedelta comparison – works but hard to read; extract to helper.
server.py insights date filter (lines 562-572): same confusing ternary may silently treat tz-naive timestamps as tz-aware; consider `ts_dt = ts_dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` once before compare.
server.py settle endpoint: records settlement both in settlements[] AND as a balancing expense in expenses[]. Duplicate source of truth; pick one.
server.py is 753 lines – approaching 700-line split threshold; consider splitting auth/trips/insights into modules.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all critical screens render; create-split step-3 submit not clicked in automation due to text selector issue, but UI is correct – see notes)

seed_data_creation: No persistent test seed data left. Removed TEST_DelGuard trip via DELETE after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend JWT auth + 9 endpoints covered by /app/backend/tests/test_merizo_api.py. Use `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests -v` to re-run. The settle test will skip if Goa is already fully settled. Create-split wizard uses testIDs: create-name, create-start, create-end, create-dest-input, create-dest-add, create-member-input, create-member-add, cur-<CODE>, cover-<key>, and a single `create-action` button on every step (text: 'Next' / 'Next' / 'Create split'). Bottom tabs have duplicate testIDs – use `page.locator('[data-testid="tab-insights"]').last.click(force=True)` to hit the visible label.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no blocking bugs found. All user flows (login, home carousel, theme swap, dark-mode DotNum, insights donut, profile, category→create-split wizard steps 1→2→3) render correctly. Backend all endpoints return expected shapes with proper auth/ownership checks.
